mapper.sql: dish_id, dish_name, dish_status, for_sale, category_id, price, dish_sales, dish_score, dish_score_person, dish_photo_id, dish_photo, ingredients, create_time, shop_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dish (dish_name, dish_status, for_sale, category_id, price, dish_sales, dish_score, dish_score_person, dish_photo_id, dish_photo, ingredients, create_time, shop_id) VALUES (#{dishName}, #{dishStatus}, #{forSale}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{dishSales}, #{dishScore}, #{dishScorePerson}, #{dishPhotoId}, #{dishPhoto}, #{ingredients}, #{createTime}, #{shopId})
mapper.update: UPDATE dish SET dish_name = #{dishName}, dish_status = #{dishStatus}, for_sale = #{forSale}, category_id = #{categoryId}, price = #{price}, dish_sales = #{dishSales}, dish_score = #{dishScore}, dish_score_person = #{dishScorePerson}, dish_photo_id = #{dishPhotoId}, dish_photo = #{dishPhoto}, ingredients = #{ingredients} WHERE dish_id = #{dishId}
